_comment: SNOW-1505. Border crossings where datum_check.py compares swissALTI3D's heights with the national model's across the border, before the terrain build downloads anything in bulk. Each point is the road crossing, on the border; the border itself is found from where swissALTI3D's data stops, so no bearing is needed. Flat ground on purpose: only cells under 1 degree count.
